source.adaptation: Eight local review groups cover the upstream ten-item checklist, expanded paper rules and technical-plan/SOP guidance. The upstream does not itself enumerate eight categories. No upstream program or automatic rewriter is executed. Evidence-led narrative and phase-aware comparison guidance are native user-requested policy.

policy.protected_context_review: Preserve necessary scientific content while separately reviewing redundant framing; protected signals are not semantic approval.

rewrite_procedure.task: Understand the requested scope and evidence; classify the function of each candidate sentence using all six function classes.
Remove only a disclaimer that adds no evidence, scope, logic, conceptual precision or necessary reader guidance; retain all protected facts.
State positive, exact scope when scientifically equivalent; retain a negative boundary if positive wording would obscure validity or safety.
Replace stacked hedging with evidence-bounded precision; keep warranted uncertainty and name its source without increasing causal or statistical force.
Rebuild only the requested paragraph or passage around its main point, one job, logical order and contribution; perform a second self-review and record an itemized revision log.

groups.title: Direct claims and accurate positive scope
semantic_checks: State what is established, examined or proposed; do not imply that a proposed result has been observed.
Determine whether a negative scope boundary is essential to the exact claim; retain it when positive scope would mislead.

groups.title: Precision and warranted uncertainty
semantic_checks: Retain may, suggests, preliminary and under these conditions when justified; never convert association to causation.
Name design, sample, measurement or estimation uncertainty; never insert significant or comprehensive superiority for rhetorical strength.

groups.title: Paragraph purpose and placement
semantic_checks: Use one main job and a clear point per paragraph; assess logic and connection to the main argument.
Place limitations where they change interpretation, usually Methods, Discussion or Limitations; keep qualifiers essential to Abstract or Conclusion sentences.
Repeated limitation statements may be necessary across distinct claims; examine meaning before consolidating.

groups.title: Useful contrast and necessary transitions
semantic_checks: Keep contrasts that distinguish concepts, controls, mechanisms, alternative explanations or reviewer claims.
Remove a transition only when the logical relationship remains explicit and accurate.

groups.title: Necessary clarification and calm authorial posture
semantic_checks: Distinguish useful reader guidance or evidenced rebuttal from pre-emptive negotiation with an imagined critic.
Replace vague modesty or apology with exact contribution and magnitude; preserve small effects and uncertainty.

groups.title: Central contribution and paper coherence
semantic_checks: Build one problem-contribution-evidence-value spine around the strongest supported central claim; state its exact bounded advantage early and prioritize main figures and text by argument value rather than equal coverage.

Reframe the story when current evidence supports a stronger bounded contribution, recording changes in existing claim/argument records while preserving original hypotheses, outcomes and actual analysis phases.

Narrow or withdraw unsupported claims instead of appending generic caveats; conclude with the established contribution, decisive evidence and bounded value, without new results or a limitation catalogue.

groups.title: Experimental purpose, metric tradeoffs and adverse findings
semantic_checks: Before results, justify the comparison scope from the question and intended use, using competitive relevant baselines and fair conditions. A weak dimension or adverse outcome is not grounds to change scoring or remove required comparisons.

Assign each planned experiment a concrete claim-testing role; remove or redesign irrelevant or redundant planned work through normal approval, and identify the precise claim affected by a missing test.
Report measured tradeoffs, conditions, comparisons, both improving and worsening metrics and uncertainty. Keep fixed criteria and every registered outcome and failed run; unknown causes stay unknown.

Prioritize and condense presentation by declared role, relevance and adequacy; retain primary tests and interpretation-changing findings in the main text, cross-referencing supporting detail. Outcome direction or controversy alone cannot determine placement.

groups.title: Review triage, language and example integrity
semantic_checks: Classify review feedback as demonstrated problem, question needing verification or optional additional experiment; change manuscript limitations only when interpretation requires it.
Examples supply wording patterns, never facts, measurements, mechanisms, superiority claims or causal relationships.
Respect requested local scope and draft language; project manuscripts remain English even though Chinese planning text can be inspected.
In the final pass check each changed sentence against evidence and record original/revised text, function, rationale, preserved facts, source locations and unresolved questions.

In technical plans/SOPs keep operational purpose, exact operations, parameters, prerequisites and prohibitions. Replace vague conditions only with supplied evidence; do not turn a conditional action into an unconditional one or substitute a different technical verb.

checklist.text: Repeated statements of what the text does not claim
Negative framing where positive framing would work
Explanations added only to prevent hypothetical misunderstanding
Unnecessary not X but Y structures
Redundant however, nevertheless or although transitions
